document_notes: Page 156 of PIR (Antonius). Contains entry 816 (Antonius Balbus), governor of Cilicia.

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly identified as 'legatus Aug. pr. pr. provinciae Ciliciae' under Septimius Severus.

segments.name_variants: ANTONIVS BALBVS, λαμπρότατος στρατηγός, [A]vtwvio[v ...]Mou [mpe]oB[euro0] ἀντι[στρατήγου, τοῦ] λα[μπ]ροτάτο[υ]
segments.identification_and_sources: nominatur in t. Charadri in Cilicia rep., posito imperante Septimio Severo intra annos 198—209 IGR 3, 838. Vide num eiusdem legati mentio fiat in t. Olbae sub eodem imperatore dedicato IGR 3, 848.
segments.offices_and_career: sine dubio legatus Aug. pr. pr. provinciae Ciliciae.
segments.governorship_attestation: sine dubio legatus Aug. pr. pr. provinciae Ciliciae. Vide num eiusdem legati mentio fiat in t. Olbae sub eodem imperatore dedicato IGR 3, 848, ubi agnoscitur [A]vtwvio[v ...]Mou [mpe]oB[euro0] ἀντι[στρατήγου, τοῦ] λα[μπ]ροτάτο[υ], modo ut Mou levi errore descriptum esse statuamus (hunc titulum a. 198 incisum esse non ita cerium videlur).
segments.family_and_social_relations: Fortasse pater eius qui sequitur (M. Antonius Balbus, 817).
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Idem puto intelligendus est Antonius Balbus (Antoninum traditur, Antonium scribendum videtur, cum ceteri fere omnes, qui eo loco recensentur, nomine gentilicio significentur), homo nobilis ab imperatore Septimio Severo occisus vit. Sev. 13, 2 ('ubi viz omnes qui memorantur crediderim ipso a. 197 post victoriam ab Albino reportatam interfectos esse; immo videtur hoc loco auctor laterculum attulisse senatorum per totum Severi imperium inde ab a. 197 occisorum).

notes: Identified as legatus Aug. pr. pr. of Cilicia under Septimius Severus.

governorship_factoids.exact_text: legatus Aug. pr. pr. provinciae Ciliciae
notes: Attested in inscriptions from Charadrus (IGR 3, 838) and possibly Olba (IGR 3, 848).

career_factoids.exact_text: homo nobilis ab imperatore Septimio Severo occisus
notes: Mentioned in Historia Augusta, Vita Severi 13, 2 (where the text reads Antoninus, but PIR suggests correcting to Antonius).
PIR A 817, vir clarissimus, patronus coloniae Canusii a. 223.

entry_notes: The entry discusses the correction of 'Antoninus' to 'Antonius' in HA Vit. Sev. 13, 2.
